body.name: rough-case localized sign-prior diagnostic
body.construction: Fix \(d=\gamma=1\) and \(\alpha=\beta=1/10\), and draw \(\sigma=(\sigma_1,\ldots,\sigma_{M_{\mathrm{diag}}})\) uniformly from \(\{-1,1\}^{M_{\mathrm{diag}}}\). Define \(P_{0,\sigma,\ell}\) by \(e_{0,\sigma}=1/2+q_{\ell}\sum_j\sigma_jb_{j,\ell}\), \(m_{0,0,\sigma}=3/8+q_{\ell}\sum_j\sigma_jb_{j,\ell}\), and \(\tau_{0,\sigma}\equiv1/8\). Define \(P_{1,\ell}\) by \(e_1=1/2\), \(m_{0,1}=3/8-2q_{\ell}^2\sum_jb_{j,\ell}^2\), and \(\tau_1=1/8+4q_{\ell}^2\sum_jb_{j,\ell}^2\). Under each law take \(X\sim\operatorname{Unif}([0,1])\); conditional on \(X\), draw \(A\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(e(X))\) independently of conditionally independent \(Y(0)\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(m_0(X))\) and \(Y(1)\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(m_0(X)+\tau(X))\), and set \(Y=AY(1)+(1-A)Y(0)\).
